hold_text: Tier-1 work by the canonical tier table — research/backtest TOOLING, non-live, no order path, no config, no unit file, no src/. But two of the six changed files sit OUTSIDE check_pr_landing's TIER1_SURFACE and so cannot be vouched for from here: scripts/backtest_trend.py and scripts/prop/account_compat_matrix.py (verified by calling _match against TIER1_SURFACE WITH negative controls — both False, and neither is named in TIER2_PATHS or TIER3_PATHS, so this is 'the guard cannot vouch', not 'the guard says Tier-2'). The other four ARE vouched: scripts/ops/backtest_data_source.py, scripts/ops/symbol_data_binding_census.py, tests/test_backtest_data_source.py, docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json. WHAT A HUMAN IS BEING ASKED TO READ, in one line: these two harnesses now EXIT 2 when a named --symbol cannot be bound to data, where they previously ran against a default fixture and labelled the result with the symbol. That is a new refusal on a shared research fleet, so the blast radius is the thing to check, and it is bounded three ways, each asserted live rather than argued: (A) no --symbol and no --data is BYTE-IDENTICAL to before — same BTCUSDT header, same 2022-07-23->2022-07-27 span, same 144 trades, exit 0 — so every symbol-less invocation, which is the overwhelming majority, is untouched; (B) an explicit --data is used as given and NEVER second-guessed even when it contradicts the symbol, so the 251 existing --data call sites and every proxy/resample run are untouched; (C) BACKTEST_DATA_PATH is honoured exactly as before, which matters because CLAUDE.md records it as a FLEET-WIDE knob read by 23 files and corrects an earlier 'M5-only' misreading of it. THE ONE DELIBERATE BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, stated rather than buried: `--symbol BTCUSDT` typed explicitly with no --data is now refused too. Nothing establishes that data/backtest_candles.csv holds BTC — not its name, not a manifest — so a special case would assert a provenance nobody has checked. It is one flag to fix and the refusal message says which. If the manager would rather that case kept working, it is a three-line change to treat an explicitly-typed default symbol as legacy_default; I did not do it because it re-introduces an unchecked provenance claim and the row is about exactly that. This lane's standing instruction is that anything it cannot vouch for as Tier-1 is a PROPOSAL routed to the manager rather than a self-land, so it is held on that rule and not on doubt about the change.
why: Closes BL-20260813-HARNESS-SYMBOL-IS-A-LABEL-DATA-DEFAULTS-TO-BTC (open 30 days) by making `--symbol` a CONSTRAINT ON THE DATA rather than a display label, in the two harnesses that row names — and measures the class it belongs to, which turns out to be 8.5x larger. REPRODUCED BEFORE FIXING: `scripts/backtest_trend.py --symbol SOLUSDT --timeframe 1h` printed a complete result set — 144 trades, win_rate 31.25%, net_r -82.6483 — headed SOLUSDT, computed from `data 2022-07-23 21:24:00+00:00 -> 2022-07-27 08:43:00+00:00`, exit 0. That span is VERBATIM the BTC fixture span the row's criterion names. The sibling reached bt._load_candles('/home/user/ict-trader-data/btc_5m.parquet') under --symbol SOLUSDT without ever asking whether the two agreed. AFTER, running the criterion's own two commands: both exit 2, naming the symbol, the timeframe, the directory searched, the resolver used, the fallback DECLINED and why, and the one-line remedy. ⚠️ Said plainly because it would otherwise be a false pass: `--symbol SOLUSDT` alone already exited 2 on account_compat_matrix for a DIFFERENT reason ('one of --strategy or --ledger is required'), so it was run with --strategy trend_donchian to reach the engine path the defect lives on. THE FIX IS A POLICY OVER THE EXISTING RESOLVER, NOT A SECOND ONE. The (symbol, timeframe) -> file mapping already had ONE owner — scripts/research/m20_fleet_exit_sweep.py::resolve_data — which knows the data/<SYMBOL>_<grain>.csv convention, the legacy spellings, the finest-grain-<=-leg rule and the PROXY_DATA order that is itself a RECORDED decision (BL-20260814-PROXY-MAP-SHADOWS-NATIVE-DATA). scripts/ops/backtest_data_source.py IMPORTS it and adds only what it has no opinion about: what to do when nothing resolves. A second mapping would have been RC-BUILT-A-MECHANISM-THAT-ALREADY-EXISTED in its worse form — two functions answering 'which file is SOLUSDT?' that drift after the next proxy change — and a test asserts the delegation holds by parsing the module and grading its EXECUTABLE code, not its prose (mutation-checked: it fails when a rival .glob is planted). FIVE STATES, NEVER COLLAPSED: explicit / env / resolved / legacy_default / refused, with `path` None ONLY for refused — never a substituted default, which IS the defect. REFUSED rather than 'fall back and warn' deliberately: a warning is exactly what that 144-trade SOLUSDT run would have carried, and it would still have printed a win rate. AND THE CLASS IS THE MORE USEFUL HALF. The row names two instances; nobody had asked how many exist. scripts/ops/symbol_data_binding_census.py (AST, 8 planted controls, self-test PASS) measures 17 on origin/main and 15 here, over a denominator of 58 files declaring --symbol out of 2,269 parsed — and the two that disappear are exactly the two this PR fixes, which is the positive control that the instrument measures what it claims. 14 of the 15 share one fixture. Filed as its own row, BL-20260912-FIFTEEN-MORE-HARNESSES-LET-SYMBOL-BE-A-LABEL-OVER-A-DEFAULTED-DATA-FILE-AND-FOURTEEN-SHARE-ONE-FIXTURE, because fixing these two does not fix those fifteen. ⚠️ The census is deliberately NOT registered as a CI guard: at 15 findings a gate reds every PR, and the diagnostic-provenance-guard precedent is explicit that the sequence is census, drain, THEN gate. ⚠️ Two regex probes over the same tree returned 20 and 10 before the AST one; neither was reportable, and that is recorded in the census module's own docstring rather than quietly discarded. TESTS: 13 in tests/test_backtest_data_source.py, all passing, half of them the back-compat cases, plus 9 planted controls in the policy module's --self-test and 8 in the census's.
